Members.string 'NodeComment': check if the head is moving quickly, so if something like the stomper hits us, we go into ragdoll
Check if we still standing on something. If not go to ragdoll.
Check if the actor is moving quickly (like in mid-air or on a moving platform) if yes go to ragdoll

The Character receives input automatically from it's controller (which can be driven by the player or AI). Logic for the characters movement is generally stored here, whereas more core logic is stored on the controller. Storing movement logic on each type of character lets us easily swap between different characters without having to change controller. (Like moving from a third person character to a vehicle.)
Update Jetpack Fuel Display
As we use the enhanced input system, we have to add the mapping context to the controller
At begin play we assure the first thrust time is as long as the max time in air
This logic runs every frame tick - try not to do too much on tick as it can affect performance
Move 2D
Logic that drives StackOBot's telekenetic grab functionality
INPUT Jump & Jetpack: When walking do a regular jump, when in air, start the jetpack. Jetpack can only be used once until character lands again.
Damage Character
Reset 3rd Person Camera to default position
When character landed, reset the Jetpack and play an impact sound
Reset Jetpack when called by the BPI Bot Interface
Touch Input Logic
Check for grabbable items and update status of grabbed items
INPUT: Turning
INPUT: Movement
Hide UI when there is no successful trace
Show Grab UI Overlay
If reset, thruster time is set back to max thruster time

The jetpack can be started, stopped and reset here. This is called by the jump input when in air or reset when landed. The jetpack and its functionality could become an own component if you would have several characters able to use it.
The meta sound gets started. It has an ignite and a loop that is played until the JetpackOff event is triggered

The parameter interface of the metasound only exists while playing. So check before trying to pass data in. When the jetpack goes off a trigger switches of the sound. But instead just stop playing the looping part of the sound stops and a winding down sound is played.
More air control while jetpack is active
The jetpack particle effect is (de)activated
When Jetpack is active decrease the thruster time

Using ThrusterMaxTime to get a value between 0 and 1 and use that in a curve  to get the launch velocity on the character. Now you can modify the curve to get the wanted behaviour. The bot is only launched a bit at start but then the jetpack depletes .
When thruster time is 0 the jetpack is toggled off
Update Jetpack, called from tick function to decrease the thruster time. Using a curve asset to get the Z force applied on the character.
Create dynamic material instances and store the references into an array for changing it later when printing and when the bot goes into inactive state. Also set the main color by index.
